name: webq
description: CLI tool and MCP server for querying and validating Web Components against Custom Elements Manifest files.

scripts.ci: bun run format && bun run lint && bun run test && bun run build
scripts.build: tsc & bun build --compile --minify src/index.ts --target=bun-darwin-arm64 --outfile dist/webq-macos-arm64 & bun build --compile --minify src/index.ts --target=bun-darwin-x64 --outfile dist/webq-macos-x64 & bun build --compile --minify src/index.ts --target=bun-linux-x64 --outfile dist/webq-linux-x64 & bun build --compile --minify src/index.ts --target=bun-linux-arm64 --outfile dist/webq-linux-arm64 & bun build --compile --minify src/index.ts --target=bun-windows-x64 --outfile dist/webq-windows-x64.exe
scripts.install:local: bun run build && mkdir -p $HOME/.local/bin && cp dist/webq-macos-arm64 $HOME/.local/bin/webq

author: Cory Rylan
